top_signals.title: Chinese Aluminum Output Drops But Still on Course for Record
top_signals.summary: Chinese aluminum output moderated last month as export demand softened and the industry runs up against Beijing’s capacity limits.

top_signals.title: Deleted from India’s voter rolls, some Muslims face detention and deportation
top_signals.summary: A revision of India's voter roles has struck 130 million names, with omissions disproportionately affecting Muslims, India's largest minority.
